_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
For to us a child is born, to us a son is given.
You will find him wrapped in bands of cloth.
Lying in a manger, the Prince of Peace.
The angels fill the night with song.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us worship the newborn King.
Glory to God, and peace on earth. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: It is night over the fields, and the sky has split open with song — the dark is full of wings and the cold is full of light.
Glory to God in the highest!
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light; on us, who lived in deep shadow, the light has dawned.
Glory to God in the highest!
Go with the shepherds and see: a child wrapped in cloth, laid in a feeding trough, and the whole sky singing over him.
Glory to God in the highest!
For to us a child is born, and he is called the Prince of Peace. Come and adore him.
Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth! Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A great light dawns on those who walked in darkness.
Glory to God in the highest!
A child is born and laid in a manger.
Glory to God in the highest!
The night sky breaks open with angel song.
Glory to God in the highest!
Come, let us worship the Prince of Peace.
Glory to God in the highest! Amen.
